name: Jellyfin
tagline: Your media, your server, no streaming fees
description: Free software media system: movies, shows, music streaming to any device with transcoding.
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8096"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ${{cfg.media_dir}}:/media:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
